text.en: Is this Windrider Camp? I'm looking for the road, preferably one without a toll collector.
text.zh-CN: 这里是风骑营地吗？我在找路，最好是一条没有收费员的路。

text.en: Aldonza. The knight calls me Dulcinea. We send supplies to El Toboso; lately, thieves have been collecting them first.
text.zh-CN: 我叫阿尔东莎，骑士喜欢叫我杜尔西内娅。我们给托博索运补给，最近却总让贼抢先领走。

text.en: Any news about the missing wagons?
text.zh-CN: 失踪的马车有消息了吗？

text.en: Nothing new. I'm watching the road after dark. If you hear the same answer, it means the thieves haven't filed a progress report.
text.zh-CN: 还没有。我入夜后会去看路。再听到同一个回答，就是贼还没递交进展报告。

text.en: Dulcinea? Watching for wagons?
text.zh-CN: 杜尔西内娅，在等马车？

text.en: Fresh tracks. Someone is moving our supplies after dark.
text.zh-CN: 有新车辙。有人趁天黑运走了我们的补给。

text.en: Would you like company?
text.zh-CN: 需要同行的人吗？

text.en: If you follow, keep an eye on the road. Anyone offering directions to a giant is probably selling something.
text.zh-CN: 要跟来就看好路。谁要是热心指点巨人在哪里，多半另有所图。

text.en: Those aren't mill workers. Why are they hiding the wagon labels?
text.zh-CN: 那些人不像磨坊工人。他们为什么要遮住车上的标记？

text.en: Those labels are ours. And they've noticed us.
text.zh-CN: 因为那是我们的标记。他们也已经看见我们了。

text.en: That Meteor Sigil kept them off the wagon. Good aim.
text.zh-CN: 那道陨星印记把他们赶离了马车，准头不错。

text.en: Good spacing, too. I'm the combat trainer. I teach people to handle trouble without becoming more of it.
text.zh-CN: 站位也不错。我是这里的战技教官，教人解决麻烦，而不是给麻烦添人手。

text.en: We found our supplies. They were hiding the labels.
text.zh-CN: 找到补给了。他们把车上的标记遮住了。

text.en: And apparently a giant was supposed to get the blame.
text.zh-CN: 而且，他们似乎准备让一个巨人背锅。

text.en: Know your own strengths before you choose your next lesson. Want a field test?
text.zh-CN: 选下一门技艺前，先认清自己的本事。要做个实地考核吗？

text.en: Can the test wait? We still have people waiting for their food.
text.zh-CN: 考核能等等吗？大家还等着粮食。

text.en: The field test can wait. Let's get the supplies back first.
text.zh-CN: 考核可以等，先把补给送回去。

text.en: A sound decision. Even the best footwork is less impressive on an empty stomach.
text.zh-CN: 决定得不错。步法再漂亮，空着肚子也不好发挥。

text.en: Thank you. That was the help I was asking for.
text.zh-CN: 谢谢。这才是我刚才想要的帮助。

text.en: I'll check the camp. Meet me there when you're ready.
text.zh-CN: 我先回营地看看，准备好后在那里碰面。

text.en: Freedom is one of heaven's most precious gifts. I won't leave these people in a giant's prison!
text.zh-CN: 自由是上天最珍贵的馈赠之一。我不能把这些人留在巨人的牢笼里！

text.en: A prison? We live here. Those are chicken fences. Your men just broke one.
text.zh-CN: 牢笼？我们住在这里。那是鸡栏，你的人刚拆了一处。

text.en: Who told you about the giant?
text.zh-CN: 谁告诉你这里有巨人的？

text.en: Gines de Pasamonte. He said the sacks were stolen tribute. A very persuasive fellow.
text.zh-CN: 希内斯·德·帕萨蒙特。他说那些袋子里装的是搜刮来的贡品。那人说得很有说服力。

text.en: The sacks are ours. His men are hauling them away. Please help me stop them.
text.zh-CN: 袋子是我们的。他的人正在往外搬，请帮我拦住他们。

text.en: Stand aside, Sir Knight. Helping these people starts with leaving their food alone.
text.zh-CN: 请让开，骑士先生。帮助这些人，得先别动他们的粮食。

text.en: The knight has pulled back. Where were those men taking the wagons?
text.zh-CN: 骑士退开了。那些人要把马车运到哪里？

text.en: The old windmill storehouse. Gines has been calling it a giant's treasury.
text.zh-CN: 旧风车粮仓。希内斯把那里说成了巨人的宝库。

text.en: That sounds more profitable than calling it a warehouse.
text.zh-CN: 听起来确实比叫粮仓值钱。

text.en: My neighbors need the grain inside. That's the treasure I'm worried about.
text.zh-CN: 我的邻居需要里面的粮食。那才是我担心的宝贝。

text.en: We've compared notes. Let's go after that wagon together.
text.zh-CN: 线索已经对上了，一起去追那辆马车吧。

text.en: Good. I'll watch the road. You watch for anyone selling us another giant.
text.zh-CN: 好。我看路，你提防那些还想给我们介绍巨人的人。

text.en: The tracks end here. Windmill Storehouse.
text.zh-CN: 车辙到这里就停了。风车粮仓。

text.en: Someone painted a giant's footprint on the door.
text.zh-CN: 有人在门上画了个巨人的脚印。

text.en: Turn back! The giant collects travelers, too!
text.zh-CN: 回去！巨人也收藏旅人！

text.en: The footprint is still wet. Your giant works fast.
text.zh-CN: 脚印还没干。你那巨人干活真快。

text.en: Gines! Leave the villagers' goods where they are.
text.zh-CN: 希内斯！把村民的东西留在原处。

text.en: Father Perez, keep back. He's been stealing spellbooks, too.
text.zh-CN: 佩雷斯神父，先退开。他还偷了法术书。

text.en: Gines. You told the knight this camp was a prison.
text.zh-CN: 希内斯。是你告诉骑士，这座营地是牢笼。

text.en: He wanted someone to rescue. I merely supplied a location.
text.zh-CN: 他想救人。我不过是提供了一个地点。

text.en: And a story that let your men carry away our food.
text.zh-CN: 还有一个能让你的人搬走我们粮食的故事。

text.en: A good story opens more doors than a good lockpick.
text.zh-CN: 好故事可比好撬锁工具更会开门。

text.en: Then you can tell it to the guards. Father Perez has gone to fetch them.
text.zh-CN: 那就留着讲给守卫听。佩雷斯神父已经去找他们了。

text.en: We'll get the wagons home. No giants required.
text.zh-CN: 我们会把马车送回去，用不着巨人帮忙。

text.en: The wagons are heading home. The knight is helping mend the fence he broke.
text.zh-CN: 马车已经回去了。骑士正在帮忙修他拆坏的围栏。

text.en: How is the fence taking his apology?
text.zh-CN: 围栏愿意接受他的道歉吗？

text.en: Better than the chickens. I'd like to travel with you. We work well together.
text.zh-CN: 比鸡们愿意。我想和你同行，我们配合得不错。

text.en: Then we'll keep learning. One road and one battle at a time.
text.zh-CN: 那就继续学下去，一段路、一场战斗，慢慢来。

text.en: There was a Bloodthorn Bolt tome in the stolen crate. We can study it. The trainer can explain the notes; Gines mostly drew skulls.
text.zh-CN: 被偷的箱子里还有一本血棘飞矢法术书，可以拿来研习。教官看得懂批注；希内斯大多只画了骷髅头。

text.en: So that's where he gets his big ideas.
text.zh-CN: 难怪他的主意总是那么惊人。

text.en: Time to practice together. If we both shout 'I've got this', one of us still needs to watch the flank.
text.zh-CN: 该一起练练了。就算两个人都喊“交给我”，也总得有一个记得看侧翼。

text.zh-CN: 该一起练练了。就算两个人都喊“交给我”，也总得有一个记得看侧翼。

text.en: Rochefort wants the ledger, Milady. And the names you copied.
text.zh-CN: 米莱狄，罗什福尔要那本账册，还有你抄下的名字。

text.en: Five armed men for a lady's reading notes. How flattering.
text.zh-CN: 为了女士的读书笔记，竟来了五个带剑的男人。真抬举我。

text.en: You can settle your reading habits without threatening the caravan.
text.zh-CN: 你们的阅读纠纷，用不着拿整个商队来解决。

text.en: Milady de Winter. An excellent entrance, traveler. Let's put it to use.
text.zh-CN: 米莱狄·德温特。旅人，你登场得很漂亮。别浪费这份本事。

text.en: What did you read that was worth five swords?
text.zh-CN: 什么笔记，值得别人动用五把剑？

text.en: Payments. Names. Things powerful men prefer to forget. Rochefort's holding my courier at the Cardinal's Tower.
text.zh-CN: 款项、人名，还有大人物希望忘掉的事。罗什福尔把我的信使关在枢机塔。

text.en: I'll help get the courier out. That doesn't make me part of your schemes.
text.zh-CN: 我可以帮忙救人，但别把我算进你的阴谋里。

text.en: Of course. We have a common interest. For now, that's more useful than trust.
text.zh-CN: 当然。我们利益相同。目前，这比信任更管用。

text.en: I'll travel with you. Take this Threefold Swordplay Manual. Even a useful ally needs practice.
text.zh-CN: 我和你一起走。这本三段剑术手册拿着。有用的盟友，也得练习。

text.en: A letter from Grimm?
text.zh-CN: 格林的信？

text.en: Come see me.
text.zh-CN: 回来见我。

text.en: Concise. He must be saving ink for the stories.
text.zh-CN: 真简短。他一定把墨水留给故事了。

text.en: Field note: visiting Grimm advances the world story. Some unfinished encounters may close permanently. Finish what matters to you and save before returning.
text.zh-CN: 旅途提示：回访格林会推进世界剧情，一些未完成的事件可能永久关闭。先完成你在意的路线，返回前记得保存。

text.en: D'Artagnan. Still rushing into other people's affairs?
text.zh-CN: 达达尼昂，又急着插手别人的事？

text.en: You locked up a courier for carrying a letter. I'd call that an invitation.
text.zh-CN: 你把一个送信的人关了起来。我就当这是给我的请帖。

text.en: Milady sent us. I'm beginning to suspect she left out a few details.
text.zh-CN: 米莱狄让我们来救人。我开始怀疑她漏讲了不少细节。

text.en: She usually does. Get me past these guards; I'll bring the courier out.
text.zh-CN: 她向来如此。替我挡住守卫，我去把信使带出来。

text.en: The prisoner stays. Guards, make sure our guests understand.
text.zh-CN: 囚犯留下。卫兵，让客人们听明白。

text.en: Rescue first. Explanations afterward.
text.zh-CN: 先救人，解释留到之后。

text.en: You've freed one messenger. You haven't silenced the names in that ledger.
text.zh-CN: 你们放走了一个信使，可账册上的名字不会就此消失。

text.en: The courier is safe. I'll see him clear of the tower. Keep these training guides; you've earned them.
text.zh-CN: 信使安全了。我送他离开塔楼。这些教材给你，你值得这份谢礼。

text.en: And Rochefort? He doesn't look ready to call it a day.
text.zh-CN: 那罗什福尔呢？他看起来可不打算收工。

text.en: Return to Rose Caravan. I'll meet you there. Keep an eye on Milady, too—she never tells the whole story.
text.zh-CN: 回蔷薇商队，我会去找你。也留心米莱狄，她从不把话说全。

text.en: The ledger, Milady. Then every witness comes with me.
text.zh-CN: 米莱狄，交出账册。所有证人也跟我走。

text.en: You want my information and my silence. Such an ambitious shopping list.
text.zh-CN: 既要我的情报，又要我闭嘴。你的购物清单真不客气。

text.en: D'Artagnan, at your service. The courier's out of reach. These travelers are leaving freely, too.
text.zh-CN: 达达尼昂，愿意效劳。信使已经安全离开，这些旅人也要自由离开。

text.en: You're willing to fight beside Milady?
text.zh-CN: 你愿意和米莱狄并肩作战？

text.en: Beside her, yes. With my back to her? Let's not rush things.
text.zh-CN: 并肩，可以。把后背交给她？我们还是慢慢来。

text.en: A temporary truce, then. Do try to survive your suspicions.
text.zh-CN: 那就暂时休战。可别忙着疑心，忘了活下来。

text.en: Enjoy your little alliance. I know how quickly its loyalties can change.
text.zh-CN: 好好享受这点同盟之情吧。我知道，有些人的忠诚变得有多快。

text.en: The caravan can move on, and the courier is free. I'll stay with you. All for one, and one for all!
text.zh-CN: 商队能继续赶路，信使也自由了。我会留下与你同行。人人为我，我为人人！

text.en: I'll take the help. We can argue about trust on the road.
text.zh-CN: 有你帮忙就好。信不信得过，咱们路上再争。

text.en: With Milady along, we'll have plenty to discuss. Take this Drifting Cloud Sword Manual. There's more to learn together.
text.zh-CN: 米莱狄在，肯定不愁没话说。拿上这本流云剑术手册，我们能一起练的还多。

text.en: Halt! Official ferry toll. Very official. We've made a sign.
text.zh-CN: 站住！正式渡口收费。非常正式，我们还写了牌子。

text.en: I held the sign while it dried.
text.zh-CN: 牌子晾干时，是我负责扶着的。

text.en: Impressive credentials. Who appointed you?
text.zh-CN: 资历真不错。谁任命你们的？

text.en: We took a vote. Four in favor.
text.zh-CN: 我们投过票，四票赞成。

text.en: No one opposed. Excellent turnout.
text.zh-CN: 无人反对，投票率很高。

text.en: I'd like to inspect your permit before you inspect my purse.
text.zh-CN: 在你们检查我的钱包之前，我想先检查你们的许可。

prompt.en: How do you answer the toll collectors?

text.en: Your permit appears to have expired.
text.zh-CN: 你们的许可，好像过期了。

text.en: A temporary administrative setback!
text.zh-CN: 只是暂时的行政挫折！

text.en: I told you we needed a larger sign.
text.zh-CN: 早说了，牌子得做大一点。

text.en: Four grown men charging travelers for a river they don't own. How enterprising.
text.zh-CN: 四个大人，替不属于自己的河收费。真会做生意。

text.en: Blue Fairy! This traveler wants the paired seals!
text.zh-CN: 蓝仙女！这位旅人想抢那对印记！

text.en: I wanted a receipt. The story seems to be growing.
text.zh-CN: 我只是想要张收据，事情怎么越传越大？

text.en: The seals stay with us. You can argue with my wooden sword.
text.zh-CN: 印记得留下。想讲道理，可以先问我的木剑。

text.en: Pinocchio, be careful. We still don't know this traveler.
text.zh-CN: 匹诺曹，小心些，我们还不认识这位旅人。

text.en: You've made your point. If it's the paired seals you want, let Pinocchio be.
text.zh-CN: 你已经证明本事了。如果你要的是这对印记，别再伤害匹诺曹。

prompt.en: What will you do about the paired seals?

text.en: Keep them. I came for the ferry, not somebody else's keepsake.
text.zh-CN: 你们留着吧。我是来坐船的，不是来抢别人的纪念物。

text.en: Then perhaps we should have started with introductions.
text.zh-CN: 那么，我们也许该先自我介绍。

text.en: Pinocchio. These seals are supposed to make their keeper unbeatable.
text.zh-CN: 我叫匹诺曹。听说这对印记，能让持有者天下无敌。

text.en: We've just conducted a fairly thorough test of that claim.
text.zh-CN: 刚才那场，算是相当充分的实测了。

text.en: Together they say, 'Kindness outlasts force.' Oh. That may explain the results.
text.zh-CN: 合起来写的是：善意胜过蛮力。哦，难怪刚才会那样。

text.en: A lesson worth keeping, even without a trophy.
text.zh-CN: 即使没有战利品，这课也值得记住。

text.en: Captain Orlando, royal collector. Hand over the seals.
text.zh-CN: 皇家征收官，奥兰多队长。交出印记。

text.en: You may have them. They don't do what you think.
text.zh-CN: 可以给你，它们没有你想的那种本事。

text.en: Then I'll take the witnesses, too.
text.zh-CN: 那证人也一并带走。

text.en: Ah. Another permit problem.
text.zh-CN: 啊，又是一桩手续问题。

data.reason: Lost the original solo finale; restore a full pre-encounter export and train normally.

text.en: Halt! Official ferry toll. Very official. We've made a sign.
text.zh-CN: 站住！正式渡口收费。非常正式，我们还写了牌子。

text.en: I held the sign while it dried.
text.zh-CN: 牌子晾干时，是我负责扶着的。

text.en: Impressive credentials. Who appointed you?
text.zh-CN: 资历真不错。谁任命你们的？

text.en: We took a vote. Four in favor.
text.zh-CN: 我们投过票，四票赞成。

text.en: No one opposed. Excellent turnout.
text.zh-CN: 无人反对，投票率很高。

text.en: I'd like to inspect your permit before you inspect my purse.
text.zh-CN: 在你们检查我的钱包之前，我想先检查你们的许可。

prompt.en: How do you answer the toll collectors?

text.en: Your permit appears to have expired.
text.zh-CN: 你们的许可，好像过期了。

text.en: A temporary administrative setback!
text.zh-CN: 只是暂时的行政挫折！

text.en: I told you we needed a larger sign.
text.zh-CN: 早说了，牌子得做大一点。

text.en: Four grown men charging travelers for a river they don't own. How enterprising.
text.zh-CN: 四个大人，替不属于自己的河收费。真会做生意。

text.en: Blue Fairy! This traveler wants the paired seals!
text.zh-CN: 蓝仙女！这位旅人想抢那对印记！

text.en: I wanted a receipt. The story seems to be growing.
text.zh-CN: 我只是想要张收据，事情怎么越传越大？

text.en: The seals stay with us. You can argue with my wooden sword.
text.zh-CN: 印记得留下。想讲道理，可以先问我的木剑。

text.en: Pinocchio, be careful. We still don't know this traveler.
text.zh-CN: 匹诺曹，小心些，我们还不认识这位旅人。

text.en: You've made your point. If it's the paired seals you want, let Pinocchio be.
text.zh-CN: 你已经证明本事了。如果你要的是这对印记，别再伤害匹诺曹。

prompt.en: What will you do about the paired seals?

text.en: Keep them. I came for the ferry, not somebody else's keepsake.
text.zh-CN: 你们留着吧。我是来坐船的，不是来抢别人的纪念物。

text.en: Then perhaps we should have started with introductions.
text.zh-CN: 那么，我们也许该先自我介绍。

text.en: Pinocchio. These seals are supposed to make their keeper unbeatable.
text.zh-CN: 我叫匹诺曹。听说这对印记，能让持有者天下无敌。

text.en: We've just conducted a fairly thorough test of that claim.
text.zh-CN: 刚才那场，算是相当充分的实测了。

text.en: Together they say, 'Kindness outlasts force.' Oh. That may explain the results.
text.zh-CN: 合起来写的是：善意胜过蛮力。哦，难怪刚才会那样。

text.en: A lesson worth keeping, even without a trophy.
text.zh-CN: 即使没有战利品，这课也值得记住。

text.en: Captain Orlando, royal collector. Hand over the seals.
text.zh-CN: 皇家征收官，奥兰多队长。交出印记。

text.en: You may have them. They don't do what you think.
text.zh-CN: 可以给你，它们没有你想的那种本事。

text.en: Then I'll take the witnesses, too.
text.zh-CN: 那证人也一并带走。

text.en: Ah. Another permit problem.
text.zh-CN: 啊，又是一桩手续问题。

text.en: Freedom is one of heaven's most precious gifts. I won't leave these people in a giant's prison!
text.zh-CN: 自由是上天最珍贵的馈赠之一。我不能把这些人留在巨人的牢笼里！

text.en: A prison? We live here. Those are chicken fences. Your men just broke one.
text.zh-CN: 牢笼？我们住在这里。那是鸡栏，你的人刚拆了一处。

text.en: Who told you about the giant?
text.zh-CN: 谁告诉你这里有巨人的？

text.en: Gines de Pasamonte. He said the sacks were stolen tribute. A very persuasive fellow.
text.zh-CN: 希内斯·德·帕萨蒙特。他说那些袋子里装的是搜刮来的贡品。那人说得很有说服力。

text.en: The sacks are ours. His men are hauling them away. Please help me stop them.
text.zh-CN: 袋子是我们的。他的人正在往外搬，请帮我拦住他们。

text.en: Stand aside, Sir Knight. Helping these people starts with leaving their food alone.
text.zh-CN: 请让开，骑士先生。帮助这些人，得先别动他们的粮食。

text.en: The knight has pulled back. Where were those men taking the wagons?
text.zh-CN: 骑士退开了。那些人要把马车运到哪里？

text.en: The old windmill storehouse. Gines has been calling it a giant's treasury.
text.zh-CN: 旧风车粮仓。希内斯把那里说成了巨人的宝库。

text.en: That sounds more profitable than calling it a warehouse.
text.zh-CN: 听起来确实比叫粮仓值钱。

text.en: My neighbors need the grain inside. That's the treasure I'm worried about.
text.zh-CN: 我的邻居需要里面的粮食。那才是我担心的宝贝。

text.en: I'll follow the wagons to the windmill.
text.zh-CN: 我会沿着车辙追到风车那边。

text.en: We haven't had much time to get to know each other. I'll go with Father Perez and the other villagers.
text.zh-CN: 我们还没来得及好好认识彼此。我和佩雷斯神父、其他村民一起走。

text.en: Fair enough. Watch out for anyone offering to sell you a giant.
text.zh-CN: 有道理。小心那些热心给你介绍巨人的人。

text.en: And be careful around the crates. Those supplies belong to the camp.
text.zh-CN: 你也小心些。箱子里的补给属于营地。

text.en: Windmill Storehouse. Where the giant apparently keeps everyone's flour.
text.zh-CN: 风车粮仓。看来巨人把所有人的面粉都存到了这里。

text.en: One more step and you'll wake him!
text.zh-CN: 再走一步，你就会吵醒他！

text.en: Then he can explain why his sacks have the camp's mark on them.
text.zh-CN: 那就让他解释解释，为什么袋子上都是营地的标记。

text.en: Gines, drop that smoke pot! I can barely see.
text.zh-CN: 希内斯，把烟罐放下！我都快看不见了。

text.en: Someone's in the storehouse! Father Perez, keep the others behind me.
text.zh-CN: 有人进了粮仓！佩雷斯神父，让其他人站到我身后。

text.en: Thieves! They're taking your supplies!
text.zh-CN: 贼！他们在抢你们的补给！

text.en: I don't trust him—or anyone waving a blade in this smoke. Stay away from the crates until we can see!
text.zh-CN: 我不信他，也不信烟里挥着武器的人。看清楚之前，谁都别靠近箱子！

text.en: Stop! The smoke's clearing. It's you.
text.zh-CN: 停下！烟散了，是你。

text.en: And those crates really are yours. We've been fighting in Gines's curtain call.
text.zh-CN: 箱子也确实是你们的。我们刚才都在给希内斯的谢幕演出捧场。

text.en: Very moving. Could we skip the part where anyone asks who owned the smoke pot?
text.zh-CN: 真感人。能跳过追问烟罐是谁的那一段吗？

text.en: You painted the footprint to scare us away from our own food.
text.zh-CN: 你画了脚印，把我们从自己的粮食旁边吓走。

text.en: Why hire a giant when people will do the frightened part for free?
text.zh-CN: 能让大家免费表演害怕，何必花钱雇巨人？

text.en: Father Perez and I will take the wagons home. The guards can deal with him.
text.zh-CN: 我和佩雷斯神父会把马车送回去，剩下的交给守卫。

text.en: What about the crate marked 'Treasure'?
text.zh-CN: 那只写着“宝藏”的箱子呢？

text.en: Books. Knights, castles, impossible promises. There's always a market.
text.zh-CN: 书。骑士、城堡、不可能兑现的承诺。总有人买账。

text.en: Keep that copy of Amadis of Gaul safe until we sort out the books. The knight has been asking about it.
text.zh-CN: 整理清楚之前，请先收好这本《阿马迪斯·德·高拉》。那位骑士一直在找它。

text.en: A book about knights. That explains quite a lot.
text.zh-CN: 一本骑士小说。这下好多事都说得通了。

item.zh-CN: 《阿马迪斯·德·高拉》追回的旧本

text.en: The giant's treasury turned out to be stolen supplies and a crate of books. Is this copy of Amadis yours?
text.zh-CN: 巨人的宝库里只有赃物和一箱书。这本《阿马迪斯》是你的吗？

text.en: Amadis of Gaul! I have crossed half the country to rediscover my own reading list.
text.zh-CN: 《阿马迪斯·德·高拉》！我跑过半个国家，结果又找回了自己的书单。

text.en: Gines used you. The villagers still need their fence repaired.
text.zh-CN: 希内斯利用了你，村民的围栏也还需要修。

text.en: I know who I am. A knight must make amends when his help has caused harm. May I travel with you?
text.zh-CN: 我知道自己是谁。骑士的帮助若造成了伤害，就该设法弥补。我能与你同行吗？

item.zh-CN: 《阿马迪斯·德·高拉》追回的旧本

outcomes.note: Rewritten windmill story; normal difficulty, actual rewards, equipment, mastery, spell study and reload verified. The knight ending is a separate observed trial.
Ending and required deployment verified; this does not establish original-engine difficulty parity.
Earlier trial: first two fights won twice; the solo finale lost twice. Pinocchio has NOT been recruited. Blue Fairy is a story ally.
